recommendation_summary: Add a ping that fires only on success at the end of nightly-sync to a daily Healthchecks.io check with a grace period of about 30 minutes, so a missing ping triggers an alert, and keep the Synology out of it for now.
note: The reply recommends one hosted dead-man alert and puts the Synology off until there are logs worth searching, but it has none of the four labelled record lines.
